idle people have the least leisure..m: Prov. If you are not energetic and hardworking, you will never have any free time, since you will have to spend all your time finishing your work. _My grandmother always told me not to dawdle, since idle people have the least leisure.

in the black.m: Có lãi, làm ăn có lợi nhuận, không bị mắc nợ.
in the black.en: Fig. not in debt; in a financially profitable condition. (As opposed to in the red.) _ I wish my accounts were in the black. _Sally moved the company into the black.
in the black.ex: After a tough year, the company is finally in the black.

out of the ordinary.m: unusual. _ It was a good meal, but not out of the ordinary. _ Your report was nicely done, but nothing out of the ordinary.
out of the ordinary.en: unusual. _ It was a good meal, but not out of the ordinary. _ Your report was nicely done, but nothing out of the ordinary.

out of the picture.m: Fig. no longer relevant to a situation; departed; dead. _ Now that Tom is out of the picture, we needn’t concern ourselves about his objections. _ With her husband out of the picture, she can begin living as she pleases.
out of the picture.en: Fig. no longer relevant to a situation; departed; dead. _ Now that Tom is out of the picture, we needn’t concern ourselves about his objections. _ With her husband out of the picture, she can begin living as she pleases.

out of the question.m: Không thể được, không đáng bàn tới.
out of the question.en: Fig. not allowed; not permitted. _ I’m sorry, but your taking my car is out of the question. _ You can’t go to Florida this spring. We can’t afford it. It’s out of the question.
out of the question.ex: Traveling abroad this year is out of the question given our budget.

out of the red.m: Fig. out of debt; into profitability. _ This year our company is likely to get out of the red before fall. _If we can cut down on expenses, we can get out of the red fairly soon.
out of the red.en: Fig. out of debt; into profitability. _ This year our company is likely to get out of the red before fall. _If we can cut down on expenses, we can get out of the red fairly soon.

out of the running.m: Fig. no longer being considered; eliminated from a contest. _ After the first part of the diving meet, three members of our team were out of the running. _ After the scandal was made public, I was out of the running. I pulled out of the election.
out of the running.en: Fig. no longer being considered; eliminated from a contest. _ After the first part of the diving meet, three members of our team were out of the running. _ After the scandal was made public, I was out of the running. I pulled out of the election.

out of the woods.m: Thoát khỏi nguy hiểm, qua cơn nguy kịch.
out of the woods.en: Fig. past a critical phase; out of the unknown. _When the patient got out of the woods, everyone relaxed. _ I can give you a better prediction for your future health when you are out of the woods.
out of the woods.ex: After months of treatment, the doctors finally said he was out of the woods.

ring a bell.en: Fig. [for something] to cause someone to remember something or for it to seem familiar. _ I’ve never met John Franklin, but his name rings a bell. _ Whenever I see a bee, it rings a bell. I remember when I was stung by one.
ring a bell.ex: Her name rings a bell, but I can’t place where I know her from.

ring back.en: to call back on the telephone. _ No, there’s no message. I’ll ring back later. _ She’s not here now. I suggest you ring back after dinner.
ring back.ex: I phoned and left a message this morning but she still hasn't rung me back.

ring in the new year.m: Fig. to celebrate the beginning of the new year at midnight on December 31. _We are planning a big party to ring in the new year. _How did you ring in the new year?
ring in the new year.en: Fig. to celebrate the beginning of the new year at midnight on December 31. _We are planning a big party to ring in the new year. _How did you ring in the new year?

ring off the hook.m: Fig. [for a telephone] to ring incessantly and repeatedly. _ What a busy day! The telephone has been ringing off the hook all day long. _The telephone has been ringing off the hook ever since the ad appeared in the paper.
ring off the hook.en: Fig. [for a telephone] to ring incessantly and repeatedly. _ What a busy day! The telephone has been ringing off the hook all day long. _The telephone has been ringing off the hook ever since the ad appeared in the paper.

ring out.m: Tạo ra âm thanh lớn đột ngột.
